items.stem: When is a low-code platform generally a good fit?

options.text: For internal/line-of-business apps with standard data, forms and workflow needs delivered quickly
options.rationale: Correct: low-code excels at common business apps built fast.

options.text: For every system regardless of complexity or scale
options.rationale: Low-code has real limits for complex/high-scale needs.

options.text: Only for apps that never touch data
options.rationale: Data handling is a core low-code strength.

options.text: Only when no business users will ever use it

items.explanation: Correct: low-code excels at common business apps built fast.

items.stem: Why does governance matter when citizen developers build low-code apps?

options.text: Without access control, environments and oversight, ungoverned apps create security and maintenance risks
options.rationale: Correct: governance keeps proliferation safe and supportable.
It is about control, not performance.

options.text: Governance removes the need for data modelling
Governance converts the app to custom code
options.rationale: It does not change the implementation.

items.explanation: Correct: governance keeps proliferation safe and supportable.

items.stem: Which statements about low-code development are correct? (Select TWO)

options.text: Many platforms allow custom code or components to extend beyond built-in features
options.rationale: Correct: extensibility handles cases the visual tools cannot.

options.text: Complex, high-scale, or highly bespoke systems may be better as pro-code
options.rationale: Correct: recognising low-code's limits is part of the skill.

options.text: Low-code eliminates any need for data modelling
options.rationale: False; a sound data model is still essential.

options.text: Credentials should be hardcoded into integration steps
options.rationale: False; secrets belong in managed connections, not hardcoded.

items.explanation: Correct: extensibility handles cases the visual tools cannot.; Correct: recognising low-code's limits is part of the skill.
